scope: R2.3 first tool increment; R2-A08 restoration still pending

requirements.behavior: Retain source recovery-point time separately from repeated verification time.
requirements.invariant: Downloading again cannot make an old source point fresh.
requirements.failure: WARNING for a verified point older than 26 hours; invalid or missing evidence is UNKNOWN.

requirements.behavior: Check the entire listed batch, including cached archives, with the current key before publication or pruning.
requirements.invariant: A later bad item or interrupted transfer cannot advance accepted receipts or prune the prior valid archive.
requirements.failure: Stop with private diagnostics; retain the previous accepted recovery point.
requirements.runtime: 10 real-age checks; locally simulated transport; no cloud SSH or database-restore claim.

requirements.behavior: Bind sidecar facts to authenticated archive metadata and the selected instance/source/image.
requirements.invariant: A rewritten sidecar time or foreign source cannot establish a fresh point.
requirements.failure: Refuse conflicting/foreign facts; UNKNOWN on changed keys, absent archives, invalid receipts or stale server observations.

requirements.behavior: Retain seven server and thirty Mac UTC-day copies, selecting the last complete copy per day.
requirements.invariant: Pruning follows complete verification; unrelated files are retained.

requirements.behavior: Expose independent restore as a separate unresolved fact.
requirements.invariant: Creation/decryption alone cannot imply successful independent database restoration.
requirements.failure: Restored remains UNKNOWN; whole recovery observation exits 3.

requirements.actor: private recovery operator and independent business reviewer
requirements.behavior: Restore a downloaded archive into a distinct empty PostgreSQL target and compare all business/association facts.
requirements.invariant: Do not stamp a restore receipt until image/schema, original point, target identity, all facts and elapsed time are verified.
requirements.failure: Retain UNKNOWN and the previous source; never restore over the Mac.

requirements.behavior: Open current Word/PDF directly from the repository landing page.
requirements.invariant: One visible current-report directory with fixed student-name/number filenames; dated historical reports retain their bytes.
requirements.failure: Broken links or digest differences fail documentation delivery.
requirements.evidence: 143 initial local navigation links, complete checksums, exact renamed binary digests and five public GitHub file metadata checks; final document evidence is recorded separately.
